text:
Maya Chen: Sharing quick mock — want feedback on sampler label and keyboard focus behavior. https://figma.com/file/xyz (inline zoom on hover)
Diego Ramos: Nice! love the inline zoom idea, gives more context without opening a modal :sparkles:
Priya Patel: Quick nit: 'Sampling' as a label might be ambiguous to PMs. Maybe 'Sample rate' or 'Trace sampling'?
Maya Chen: Good point. 'Sample rate' feels clearer. Also debating whether p95 tooltip should show example queries or just numbers.
Samir Gupta: Keep tooltip numeric-first (p50/p95/p99) then a small link "show example traces" to expand — avoids clutter.
Priya Patel: Agree. Also accessibility: keyboard users need a visible focus ring on the sampler knob and the time-zoom pill.
Maya Chen: Proposed focus CSS:
```
.sampler-knob:focus {
  outline: 3px solid var(--focus-600);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
```
Maya Chen: And aria props:
```
role="slider" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="25" aria-label="Sample rate"
```
aria-bot: Accessibility check passed: focus color contrast OK, slider role detected :a11y:
Diego Ramos: Heatmap color stops — current blues are hard to read for R/G colorblind. Propose switch to a colorblind-friendly palette (purple -> orange).
Priya Patel: Also can we add a p95 sparklines mini in the legend? small 24px sparkline next to p95 label for quick trend glance.
Samir Gupta: Implementation detail: sparklines should be SVG with viewBox and no heavy JS — keep perf.
Maya Chen: UX question: when user drags time range, should sampling auto-adjust (e.g., reduce sample rate at longer ranges)?
Diego Ramos: I'd avoid auto changes without explicit affordance. Maybe show a subtle banner: "Long range selected — sampling reduced to 10% to keep preview fast" with an opt-out toggle.
Priya Patel: Copy for banner: "Long time range may degrade live preview — reduce sampling to improve responsiveness." CTA: 'Adjust sampling' or 'Keep as is'.
Samir Gupta: Agree on banner. Also add keyboard shortcut hint: `K` toggles sampler preview.
Maya Chen: Last ask — microcopy for p95 tooltip: "p95 latency (95% of requests are faster than this)." Short and friendly.
Diego Ramos: :thumbsup: works for me.
Priya Patel: LGTM. I'll add to the accessibility checklist: slider semantics, focus ring, and banner keyboard focus order.
Maya Chen: Thanks all — I'll update the figma and ping for a quick follow-up review.
design-bot: Screenshot uploaded: designs/redwood/latency/sampler-v3.png"
